# Purpose
This header file declares the stake-processing interface for the Flamenco code base. It defines functions that convert vote account data into stake weights, activate stake changes at an epoch boundary, refresh vote accounts, and update the in-memory caches for stake delegations and vote states. The declarations use types from the bank, account database, stake delegation, and vote state subsystems, which shows that the file connects stake accounting with epoch transition logic. It also defines `STAKE_ACCOUNT_SIZE` as a fixed size used for stake account handling.
